name: owd-platform
description: Owner-controlled continuity for Obsidian and independent AI agents, with cited handoffs, Decisions, and encrypted recovery.

DB.description: Private metadata, passkey/session records, vault indexes, audit events, and authorization policy for this one-owner deployment.

VAULT_STORAGE.description: Immutable materialized Markdown objects, encrypted age backups, and short-lived isolated restore staging for this one-owner deployment.

OAUTH_KV.description: Dedicated short-lived OAuth protocol storage for remote MCP clients; vault authorization remains authoritative in D1.

scripts.acceptance:continuity:local: vitest run apps/worker/test/collaboration.test.ts -t 'round-trips Approved and Unvetted|completes one synthetic research Run and one coding Run|completes an exact scheduled drill|coalesces scheduled replay' --config vitest.config.ts && node scripts/local-policy-continuity-drill.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm types:check && pnpm policy:check && pnpm upstream:config:check && pnpm release:check && pnpm cell:manifest:check
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && pnpm db:migrations:apply && wrangler deploy
scripts.release:check: node --test scripts/plugin-release-tag-policy.test.mjs && pnpm package:plugin && node scripts/check-release-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-release-regressions.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm test:marketing && pnpm test:continuity:harness && pnpm test:operations && vitest run && pnpm --filter @owd/yaos-core test && pnpm --filter @owd/folder-adapter test && pnpm --filter mdevolved test && pnpm --filter mdevolved build && pnpm --filter @owd/desktop test && pnpm --filter @owd/obsidian-plugin test
scripts.test:md2:acceptance: pnpm --filter @owd/yaos-core test && pnpm --filter @owd/folder-adapter test && pnpm --filter mdevolved test && pnpm --filter mdevolved build && pnpm --filter @owd/desktop test && vitest run apps/worker/test/source-descriptor-pairing.test.ts apps/worker/test/migrations-source-descriptor-upgrade.test.ts apps/worker/test/snapshot.test.ts packages/contracts/test/source-descriptor.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts && pnpm test:clean-install:mdevolved
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p packages/folder-adapter/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/mdevolved-cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit
